newsitem.title: FRANCE: Chirac condemns "cowardly" ETA kidnap killing.
newsitem.headline: Chirac condemns "cowardly" ETA kidnap killing.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac on Sunday condemned the "cowardly" killing of a young Spanish politician by Basque separatists and pledged greater than ever support in fighting terrorism.
"The French people learned of the cowardly assassination of Miguel Angel Blanco with horror and indignation," Chirac said in a letter to Spanish Prime Minister Jose Maria Aznar.
"The struggle against terrorism and blind violence will, more than ever, be our joint priority."
A copy of the letter was released by Chirac's office.
Blanco, a 29-year-old town councillor, died in hospital early on Sunday after being shot twice in the head on Saturday by kidnappers from the ETA separatist organisation.
The French Foreign Ministry called the killing a "cowardly and inhuman act" and said it reinforced the determination of France and Spain to work together against terrorism.
ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom) has killed more than 800 people in a 29-year fight for an independent Basque state encompassing parts of southern France and northern Spain.
French authorities have recently pledged closer co-operation with Spain and tougher action against guerrillas, whom Madrid has in the past accused of operating out of southern France.
